name: Energy Select
old_description: At Energy Select, we know energy. As a comprehensive energy solutions provider, we’re dedicated to enhancing your financial and environmental outlook through innovative conservation and production strategies. Founded in Southern Maryland, with an office in Western Maryland, we are your trusted local consultants for achieving sustainable energy success.
about:
Energy Select operates from Leonardtown in St. Mary's County, Maryland, with a second office in Western Maryland. The company describes itself as founded in Southern Maryland, though a specific founding year is not published. Ownership structure and founder names are not disclosed in public materials.

The firm provides turnkey energy services including residential and commercial solar photovoltaic installation, battery backup systems, LED lighting retrofits, electric-vehicle charger installation, energy audits, and commercial electrical work. Installations feature Enphase microinverter systems. Project scale, facility size, and headcount are not disclosed.

Customers include homeowners and businesses across Southern and Western Maryland. Energy Select partners with the Southern Maryland Electric Cooperative (SMECO) to incorporate utility rebates directly into project pricing. The company also serves commercial clients seeking lighting upgrades and EV infrastructure.

As a member-owner of the Amicus Solar Cooperative, Energy Select collaborates with a national network of independent solar contractors to share best practices and purchasing power. The company emphasizes local presence, integrated rebate handling, and a full-service approach from analysis through installation.
